title: Make Staging Gateway execution-plan expiry MariaDB-compatible

phases.objective: Persist exact Staging Gateway execution-plan expiry timestamps in a MariaDB-compatible bind type without changing the signed plan-body instant or digest.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Persist a prepared transaction-certification execution plan whose plan body carries an ISO-8601 expiry.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: MariaDB receives a valid Date bind for expires_at while the plan body retains the exact ISO instant and the same execution-plan digest.
steps: Build the governed Staging Gateway transaction-certification plan.
Validate the ISO expiry instant before persistence.
Bind expires_at to MariaDB as a Date value rather than an ISO string.
Preserve the original ISO expiry in plan_body_json so plan identity remains unchanged.
Read the saved synthetic plan back through the existing execution-plan lifecycle.
assertions: The MariaDB expires_at bind is a valid Date instance.
The SQL bind resolves to the same ISO instant recorded in plan_body_json.
No provider, DNS, custom-domain or Production mutation occurs.
No secret value is returned and secrets_included remains false.
